raw.details:
HACKIIITD 2026

National Level 24-Hour Hackathon

Organised by Tech Council, IIIT Delhi, as part of Esya '26, the official tech fest of IIIT Delhi, on 24th and 25th October.

About HackIIITD:

HackIIITD is the flagship national level hackathon organized by the Tech Council, IIIT Delhi. Designed to bring together some of the brightest student innovators, developers, designers, and problem-solvers from across the country, HackIIITD aims to create an environment where ideas evolve into impactful technological solutions.

The event is open to participants from all academic backgrounds and institutions, encouraging interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation.

  • Please do join the official whatsapp group for doubts and queries: WhatsApp group
  • Follow the official Insta handle for updates: Instagram Handle

Event Highlights:

  • National Level Hackathon
  • 24 Hour Offline Grand Finale
  • Participation Open Across India
  • No Registration Fee
  • Cash Prize Pool of ₹1,00,000+
  • Additional In Kind Rewards and Credits

Event Theme:

Round 1 is open innovation. There are no fixed problem statements, so teams choose a real-world problem in any domain of technology and propose their own solution. The finale will have separate problem statements, which will be shared with shortlisted teams.

Competition Format:

HackIIITD will be conducted in two rounds.

Round 1: Online Idea Submission

All registered teams will be required to submit a presentation deck through Unstop. They can choose any problem statement of their own, but need to explicitly explain their problem statement in details.

The submission should clearly communicate:

  • Team Details
  • Problem Statement
  • Proposed Solution
  • Target Users
  • Technical Architecture and Stack
  • Scalability, Feasibility and Use Case
  • MVP / Prototype (if available)

Following evaluation, approximately 60-70 teams will be shortlisted for the offline grand finale at IIIT Delhi.

Round 2: Offline Grand Finale

Shortlisted teams come to IIIT Delhi for a 24-hour hackathon during Esya '26.
Note: There will be different problem statements for the finale than the ones you used in online round.

During the finale, teams will:

  • Build their solutions
  • Interact with mentors
  • Participate in mentoring checkpoints
  • Receive technical and product feedback
  • Demonstrate their working solutions
  • Present their final projects before the judging panel

The finale will focus on execution, innovation, scalability, and overall impact.

Submission Guidelines:

  • Teams must submit a PPT/PDF presentation through Unstop for Round 1.
  • Recommended structure: around 7 to 8 slides in total (Not more than that)

Total: 25 Marks:

  • The highest-scoring teams will advance to the offline finals.(Please note that scores will not be released due to confidentiality)

Offline Finale Experience

  • The offline round will consist of:

Opening Ceremony

  • Introduction to the event, rules, judging process, and mentor network.
  • Hackathon Sprint
  • Teams begin building and refining their solutions.

Mentorship Sessions

Multiple mentor rounds will be conducted throughout the event.
Participants will have opportunities to:

  • Validate ideas
  • Improve technical implementation
  • Receive product feedback
  • Discuss scaling strategies
  • Improve presentations and demos

Final Demonstrations:

  • Teams will present their completed solutions before the judging panel.

Closing Ceremony:

  • Announcement of winners and distribution of prizes.
  • A detailed schedule will be released closer to the event.

Prize Pool

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹1,50,000+
  • Cash Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000+

Prize distribution details will be announced closer to the event.

Additional Benefits

Participants may also receive:

  • Cloud Credits
  • AI Tool Credits
  • Developer Platform Benefits
  • Community Perks
  • Partner Benefits
  • Exclusive Opportunities from Supporting Organizations

Subject to final partnerships and collaborations.

Eligibility:

  • Open to students across India
  • No age restriction
  • Participants from any academic background may apply
  • Cross-college teams are allowed
  • Team size must be 2–4 members
  • Solo participation is not permitted
  • No registration fee

Team Requirements

Each team must:

  • Consist of 2–4 members
  • Register through Unstop
  • Submit their Round 1 presentation before the deadline
  • Ensure all team details are correctly filled during registration

Any violation of event guidelines may result in disqualification.

Facilities for Offline Finalists

All shortlisted teams attending the finals will receive:

Infrastructure Support

  • High Speed Internet Access
  • Charging Points (Recommended to bring extension boards)
  • Power Access
  • Dedicated Working Areas

Food Support

  • Meals During Event Duration
  • Refreshments

Mentorship Support

  • Technical Mentors
  • Product Mentors
  • Industry Professionals

Event Support

  • Volunteer Assistance
  • Help Desk
  • Logistics Support

Accommodation

  • Accommodation support will be available for finalists for night stay.
  • Accommodation will be provided on a paid basis at a minimal subsidized cost.
  • Further details regarding accommodation booking and payment will be shared with shortlisted teams.

Why Participate?

  • Build solutions for real-world challenges
  • Showcase your technical and problem-solving skills
  • Learn from mentors and industry experts
  • Network with talented builders from across India
  • Gain exposure to emerging technologies
  • Strengthen your portfolio with impactful projects
  • Compete for cash prizes and additional rewards
  • Experience a national-level hackathon at IIIT Delhi

Important Note

All event timelines, judging formats, tracks, problem statements, prize distribution details, partnership announcements, and operational guidelines are subject to updates by the organizing team.

Participants are encouraged to regularly check official communication channels for announcements and updates regarding HackIIITD.

Build. Innovate. Collaborate. Create Impact.
 See you at HackIIITD!
